source_caption:
🎬 American Born Chinese (2023)

American Born Chinese follows Jin Wang, an ordinary Chinese American teenager trying to navigate the challenges of high school, friendships, family expectations, and fitting in with his classmates. Hoping for a normal teenage experience, Jin finds his life unexpectedly transformed when he is assigned to help Wei-Chen, a new international student whose mysterious background hides an extraordinary secret. What begins as an awkward friendship soon pulls Jin into an ancient conflict involving powerful figures from Chinese mythology, legendary warriors, and supernatural forces. As Jin discovers that Wei-Chen is connected to the world of the gods, he becomes caught between the familiar struggles of everyday teenage life and an incredible adventure filled with magic, martial arts, and dangerous confrontations. Meanwhile, Jin must deal with cultural stereotypes, complicated family relationships, and his growing uncertainty about his identity. Through unexpected friendships, spectacular battles, humorous encounters, and emotional discoveries, he gradually learns to embrace the parts of himself he once struggled to understand. As the conflict between mythical forces intensifies, Jin realizes that courage and self-acceptance may be more powerful than he ever imagined. Combining imaginative fantasy, exciting action sequences, heartfelt comedy, and meaningful coming-of-age storytelling, American Born Chinese explores identity, friendship, family, cultural heritage, belonging, and the extraordinary journey toward discovering who you truly are.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Comedy • Fantasy

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 30–40 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Kelvin Yu

✍️ Based on the Graphic Novel By: Gene Luen Yang

📺 Where to Watch: Originally released on Disney+. Check current streaming or digital purchase availability in your region, as the series was later removed from Disney+.

source_details.synopsis: American Born Chinese is an American fantasy action comedy television sitcom created by Kelvin Yu for Disney+. It follows tenth-grader Jin Wang (Ben Wang), who is struggling to fit in with his peers. When he is tasked with showing new exchange student Wei-Chen (Jimmy Liu) around, he is unexpectedly thrust into a battle between mythical Chinese gods, including Sun Wukong (Daniel Wu) and Guanyin (Michelle Yeoh). The series is based on the 2006 graphic novel American Born Chinese by Gene Luen Yang, who drew inspiration from his own adolescent years in the 1990s, incorporating elements from Chinese folk tales and mysticism found in the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West.
